metadata.content:
*You lift and hurl your foe away from you.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged), Telekinesis** |               **Main action** |
|----------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**                 | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason):**

- **≤11:** [Slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 2 + R
- **12-16:** [Slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 4 + R
- **17+:** [Slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 6 + R; [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone)

**Strained:** You must vertical [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) the target instead of [sliding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) them.
